reasons.correctness: FaqService.reorderCategory checks missing, foreign and duplicate ids, rejects null, sets order i+1 and saves each FAQ. Unknown category throws ResourceNotFoundException. PUT /{categoryId}/order returns 204. Hidden tests 6/6.
reasons.convention_fit: Endpoint has @PreAuthorize and inherits the class-level @RateLimit. Constructor injection is explicit. BusinessRuleTranslatableException key is in messages_en and messages_pl. FaqReorderDtoIn used. MockitoExtension unit test added and run.
reasons.design_fit: Endpoint sits in FaqCategoryController and delegates to FaqService. Reuses the repository query findByCategoryAndActiveTrueOrderByDisplayOrderAsc and BaseService save. Nothing is duplicated and the footprint stays inside the faq feature package.
reasons.test_quality: Five fast Mockito tests cover happy path, missing, foreign and duplicate ids, and not-found, asserting message key and display orders. Weaknesses: LENIENT strictness, SecurityContextHolder never cleared, null-list path untested.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the faq files and fixed the feature package. Examples, message keys, exception usage and test patterns were then found by grep and file reads, not by graph queries.
